0.0: Long time, no see. You may already know this, but the attack on the palace failed. The fire was too big, and it took all our time to put it out. We didn't have time to rob the Treasure Vault.
0.1: But it wasn't a total failure. It was a wake-up call to the queen, who is behaving better. For now.
0.2: I haven't seen the Prime Minister since the fire, and that worries me. I'm worried that he might've left Ariant... Forever. He was a good man. How unfortunate.
0.3: We relied so much on him, without realizing the heavy burden he bore. From now on, we must take care of ourselves.

1.0: I appreciate all that you've done for us. I don't have much to give, but take this #b#t4310085##k. We have no need of it.
